EMPTY.TITLE: No pipelines yet
EMPTY.ADMIN: Create the first pipeline to organize your sales in stages.
EMPTY.AGENT: An administrator needs to create the first pipeline.

BOARD.EMPTY_WON: What was won in the last 30 days shows up here.
BOARD.EMPTY_LOST: What was lost in the last 30 days shows up here.

LEAD_ENTRY_HINT.TOOLTIP: Every new conversation becomes a deal in the default pipeline

LEAD_ENTRY.TOGGLE: Create a deal for each new conversation
LEAD_ENTRY.DESCRIPTION: When a conversation that matches the rules below is assigned to an agent, it becomes an open deal in the default pipeline, in the first stage, and the agent becomes the owner. This setting applies to the whole account. Turning it off keeps the deals already on the board.
LEAD_ENTRY.NEEDS_DEFAULT: Create a pipeline first: it becomes the default.
LEAD_ENTRY.LISTS_HINT: Uncheck what should not become a lead. With everything checked in a list, channels and origins added later are included too. With more than one list unchecked, the conversation must match all of them.

ALERT_DAYS.LABEL: Warn when waiting more than (days)
ALERT_DAYS.HINT: After this period, the lead gets an alert badge on the column and on the board header.

CARD.HINT: Choose up to {max} fields to show under the standard card. The whole team sees the same fields on every card of this pipeline.

AI.TITLE: Pipeline AI
AI.DESCRIPTION: Uses the ChatClean AI key. You choose what it does on the deal cards and how much it may spend per month.

NEXT_STEP.TITLE: Suggest the next step
NEXT_STEP.HINT: Shows on the card what to do next with the customer.

FILL_ON_MOVE.TITLE: Fill fields when moving
FILL_ON_MOVE.HINT: When a deal changes stage, fills the required fields from the conversation.

TEMPERATURE.TITLE: Explain the temperature badge
TEMPERATURE.HINT: Shows how hot the deal is and why.

MONTHLY_CAP.LABEL: Monthly spending cap (R$)
MONTHLY_CAP.HINT: Set a value above zero to turn on any of the three.

TYPE.LABEL: Type
TYPE.LOCKED: The type was set on creation and does not change

ITEM_LABEL.LABEL: What to call each item
ITEM_LABEL.HINT: Shows on the "New…" button, on counters, on the card and on menus. You can change it later: it is only the text.

STALE_DAYS.LABEL: Deal stalled after (days)
STALE_DAYS.HINT: Every new stage starts with this limit. Won and lost do not count.
STALE_DAYS.INVALID: Use a whole number between 1 and {max}

ONE_CARD.LABEL: One card per contact
ONE_CARD.HINT: If the contact already has an open card in this pipeline, that card opens instead of creating another. Only this pipeline counts.

STAGES.LABEL: Stages
STAGES.HINT: Drag to change the order. New contact always comes first.

FORM.CLOSING_STAGES_HINT: The pipeline starts with the New contact stage. The won and lost columns are required and always close the board.

DELETE_CONFIRM.TITLE: Delete pipeline
DELETE_CONFIRM.MESSAGE: Are you sure you want to delete the pipeline {name}? Its stages are deleted too.

API.FETCH_ERROR: Could not load the pipelines. Try again.
API.DELETE_ERROR: Could not delete the pipeline. Try again.
